get_logger: get a configured logger with RichHandler for a given name using get_logger
add_file_handler: add a file handler to existing loggers by calling add_file_handler with a path
use_default_logger: use the pre-configured default_logger instance to log messages at any level
set_trace_level: set the custom TRACE logging level via environment variable MLGYM_LOG_FILE_LEVEL
configure_stream_level: configure the stream log level by setting the MLGYM_LOG_STREAM_LEVEL environment variable
